notes.title: The Abnormal Place - Upcoming Game Demo
notes.notes:
Hello there! I'm excited to announce that a demo of The Abnormal Place will be available to play during the upcoming Steam Next Fest from the 16th to the 22nd of June. Just go to the game's Steam page and click on the demo button to install and play. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1265040/The_Abnormal_Place]The Abnormal Place - Steam Page[/url]

We'd love to hear your feedback as well! To help with quality assurance please let us know if you have any technical issues with the demo, this part really helps with ensuring the upcoming early access of the game goes well. 

Join The Abnormal Place discord to discuss and improve the game:
[url=https://discord.gg/U3sr33r]The Abnormal Place - Discord - https://discord.gg/U3sr33r[/url] (Updated Discord Link)

Can't wait to have you all playing this weird and wonderful creation.

Regards,
Glenn
